prompt:
Mobile web app screen, portrait 9:16, edge to edge. ORGANISATION: list-first logbook. (1) slim kraft-brown top bar with notebook divider tabs "Todo", "Día 1 mié 21" (active cobalt), "Día 2 jue 22", "Día 3 vie 23 · Nankín". (2) A compact map strip only 28 percent tall showing the whole day's cobalt route with numbered stops (1–2 stamped, 3 highlighted, 4–7 open rings). (3) The rest of the screen is the day's logbook page: white graph paper, red vertical margin rule near the left; header "Día 1 · mié 21 oct" bold, subtitle "Llegada, siesta, Nanjing Road y noria", small figures "8 paradas · 44 km · 145–225 ¥ por persona". Then one row per stop aligned exactly to the grid lines: times in tabular numerals left of the margin ("15:15", "16:05", "17:20", "18:30", "19:20", "20:25", "21:00"); right of the margin the stop name with its state mark at the start of the row: rows 1–2 with solid cobalt round stamps and names in grey ink, row 3 "Nanjing Road: tramo hacia el Bund" fully swiped with fluorescent highlighter and a small "AHORA" label, rows 4–7 with open ink rings; small price tags "25–45 ¥", "60 ¥" right-aligned; between rows thin indented leg lines in small condensed type: "A pie · 400 m", "A pie · 1,1 km · ~15 min", "Taxi · 3 km · 15 min". A floating round cobalt play button at the bottom right. Dense but calm, perfectly aligned to the grid.

VISUAL WORLD (fixed for all comps): a traveller's all-weather field notebook translated into a mobile web app. Kraft-board brown (#B48A57) only on the shell bars; pages are bright WHITE graph paper with a very fine pale-blue 5 mm grid (#DCE7F2), NOT cream, NOT beige, NOT parchment. Ink is near-black (#1B1E22). One fluorescent highlighter yellow-green (#D9F84A) marks ONLY what is happening now. Each trip day has its own saturated index-tab colour (day 1 cobalt #2453D1, day 2 leaf green #2E9C4E, day 3 magenta #C8327E, day 4 orange #EE7A1B). Typography: ONE plain workhorse grotesque sans-serif family throughout, with a condensed width for small labels and tabular numerals for times; no serif, no handwriting, no script fonts, no monospace. State vocabulary drawn as ink marks: finished stops get a round rubber-stamp impression in the day colour with the stop number (slightly rotated, solid ink); the current stop and the current route leg get a fluorescent highlighter swipe; upcoming stops are open ink rings with the number; optional stops are dashed rings. No doodles, no coffee stains, no tape, no paper texture beyond the faint grid, no Chinese ornaments, no lanterns, no device frame, no browser chrome: render the phone screen itself edge to edge, portrait. Standard mobile controls (tabs, buttons, slider) that an engineer can build with HTML/CSS. All text crisp and legible at phone size.
REAL CONTENT: app "Itinerario", trip day "Día 1 · mié 21 oct · Llegada, siesta, Nanjing Road y noria", day colour cobalt. Stops of the day: H Hotel Aqua Suhe NO.1 (salida 15:00); 1 15:15 Comida en Huanghe Road (小杨生煎) — finished; 2 16:05 Nanjing Road: tramo de People's Square — finished; 3 17:20 Nanjing Road: tramo hacia el Bund (南京东路步行街) — CURRENT; 4 18:30 The Bund al encenderse las luces (外滩); 5 19:20 Jing'an Joy City: maleta y ropa; 6 20:25 Noria Sky Ring; 7 21:00 Cena en Top Banana Market. Current time 17:41. Legs show transport + straight-line distance, e.g. "A pie · 1,1 km", "Taxi · 3 km · 15 min". Prices appear as small tags like "25–45 ¥".
